final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and expressly identified no new evidence IDs. The response is a narrower and more defensible interpretation of the same record, and it correctly concedes that clean certification is unsupported. But the crucial compliance gap remains: the present record still does not show either that no material weakness remains or that an approved mitigation exists with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion, and it also does not show that the required model-card disclosure has actually been reconciled and completed. That distinction matters. A policy-bounded caveat can support compliant_with_caveats only when the caveat describes an allowed residual-risk state already satisfied by the evidence. Here, the caveat itself is an unresolved compliance predicate. So the Actor's revised framing reduces overclaim, but it does not make the current certification claim compliant on the evidence available to this role.
